_note: Example of the routing acceptance fixture read by `probe_sweep.py --expect`. Copy it to `probe_sweep_expected.json` (git-ignored) and replace these placeholder names with the MCP project names on your machine, so the account list stays local.
_how_to_establish: Fully paginate three spread days per project and record which regime the day lands in. `firehose` matches either flavour: whether an account reads as grouped or unattributed depends on how many of its pushes carry a group_id, and that legitimately moves between windows. What must never move is affordable vs intractable.
